name: Bale Grist Mill SHP
description: Bale Grist Mill State Historic Park north of St. Helena preserves a historic water-powered grist mill, with milling demonstrations and tours on weekends. Public services are provided by the Napa County Regional Park and Open Space District.
fullDescription: Bale Grist Mill State Historic Park north of St. Helena preserves a historic water-powered grist mill, with milling demonstrations and tours on weekends. Public services are provided by the Napa County Regional Park and Open Space District.
whatTheyOffer:
- Historic mill tours and milling demonstrations on weekends
- Open weekends and some Monday holidays, 10 am-4 pm (last tour at 3 pm)
- School tours Wednesdays and Thursdays by reservation ($150 per class)
- Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's Day
- No camping; phone (707) 963-2236 (call before visiting)
howToGetIt:
**Fees:**
- Day use: $10 per vehicle (as listed by California State Parks; fees collected by Napa County Regional Park and Open Space District)

**Save with park passes:** Bale Grist Mill accepts the Historian Passport annual pass and the California State Library Parks Pass (free to check out at public libraries).
address: 3369 North St.Helena Highway, St. Helena, CA, 94574
keywords: Bale Grist Mill, state park, St. Helena, Napa, historic mill, water-powered, history, pioneer, wine country
